title: IELTS Academic 21 - Listening Test 4 - Part 1
transcriptHtml:
LISTENING TRANSCRIPT - PART 1

💡 Audio-Track Sync: Bấm vào bất kỳ câu nào dưới đây để phát audio ngay đúng câu đó!

00:46ANNOUNCER: Part 1. You will hear an interviewer who is doing a survey asking a man some questions about shopping.
00:53ANNOUNCER: First, you have some time to look at questions 1 to 6.
01:33ANNOUNCER: Now listen carefully and answer questions 1 to 6.
01:41WOMAN: Good morning. I'm doing a survey of shoppers in Broadbeach. Would you have a few minutes to spare to answer some questions?
01:49MAN: Oh... erm... yes, I guess that would be ok.
01:52WOMAN: Thank you very much. Everybody seems so busy today.
01:56MAN: Well actually I don't have loads of time, so...
01:58WOMAN: Oh yes, of course. It really won't take long. Could I start by taking your name please?
02:05MAN: Martyn Leigh. Martyn's with a Y.
02:08WOMAN: And is your family name spelt L-double-E?
02:12MAN: It's L-E-I-G-H.
02:16WOMAN: Thank you. We don't actually publish your name or details. It just makes it easier for me to identify people when I look at all the results at the end.
02:26MAN: I see.
02:27WOMAN: And can I ask, how did you get into town today?
02:31MAN: Well, normally I catch the bus, but I'm on my motorbike today because I'm going to work later.
02:38WOMAN: And could you tell me what you're doing this morning, I mean, the reason for your trip into town?
02:44MAN: I've just been to the hairdresser. You see, I have a job interview at the council in a few days.
02:50WOMAN: Oh really! Well, good luck with that.
02:52MAN: Thanks a lot. And now I'm on my way to buy a suit that I can wear to the interview. I don't actually own one at the moment!
02:59WOMAN: OK. Is that everything you're planning to do in town?
03:03MAN: Yeah. Well, I've got to go and pick up my laptop. It broke a couple of days ago so I took it to the shop to get it fixed. They had to order a spare part, but apparently it's ready for collection now. I can't wait to get it back.
03:17WOMAN: I'm sure. I hate it when my technology breaks down... One more thing, it's Saturday today – is that when you like to do your shopping?
03:27MAN: Well it's more a question of when I'm free. If I'm free on a Monday, that's when I choose to come into town. The shops are less busy then, which I always prefer.
03:40ANNOUNCER: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 7 to 10.
04:18ANNOUNCER: Now listen and answer questions 7 to 10.
04:25WOMAN: So, I'd like to ask you a few more questions to get your views about shopping in Broadbeach, if that's ok.
04:31MAN: Sure. What would you like to know specifically?
04:34WOMAN: What would you say you like best about the shops here?
04:38MAN: I'd probably say it's the service you get wherever you go.
04:43WOMAN: OK. And what do you think about the range of shops in Broadbeach?
04:47MAN: Oh you can get almost anything you want here.
04:50WOMAN: And what about recent changes? What do you like and dislike about them? For example, there are a lot of new coffee shops now, are you enjoying them?
05:01MAN: No, there are too many of them. It's a shame as those places could be occupied by other kinds of shops.
05:07WOMAN: What would you like to see instead?
05:10MAN: Well, I think we have enough clothing shops. But there's only one place that sells books at the moment. It'd be nice to have a choice, you know.
05:19WOMAN: Right. And have you been to the new shopping centre outside Broadbeach yet, Martyn?
05:25MAN: Yes, once or twice. It's not that far from where I live.
05:28WOMAN: It's a very modern-looking building, isn't it?
05:30MAN: Yes, and it's lovely. The glass roof is certainly impressive. But my favourite thing is the plants they've put around the building. They're amazing, and so big already.
05:42WOMAN: And what about the entertainment facilities? Have you used any of them yet? Like the new cinema?
05:48MAN: Nah, not yet. I can't see any advantage in having it there because the one in town is actually bigger.
05:55WOMAN: OK, well thank you so much for your time.
06:00ANNOUNCER: That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: Leigh
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'Martyn Leigh... It's L-E-I-G-H.'
• Lưu ý chính tả: Đánh vần từng chữ cái L-E-I-G-H.
• Đáp án đúng: motorbike
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'normally I catch the bus, but I'm on my motorbike today...'
• Phân tích bẫy: 'bus' là phương tiện bình thường đi, hôm nay đi 'motorbike'.
• Đáp án đúng: hairdresser
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'I've just been to the hairdresser.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'has visited the hairdresser'.
• Đáp án đúng: suit
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'on my way to buy a suit that I can wear to the interview.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'buy a suit' = looking for a new suit.
• Đáp án đúng: laptop
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'pick up my laptop. It broke... ready for collection now.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'pick up / ready for collection' = collecting laptop.
• Đáp án đúng: Monday
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'If I'm free on a Monday, that's when I choose to come into town... which I always prefer.'
• Phân tích bẫy: Hôm nay là 'Saturday', nhưng ngày yêu thích đi mua sắm là 'Monday'.
• Đáp án đúng: coffee
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'there are a lot of new coffee shops now... No, there are too many of them.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'too many places selling coffee'.
• Đáp án đúng: books
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'only one place that sells books at the moment. It'd be nice to have a choice...'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'more places to buy books'.
• Đáp án đúng: plants
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'my favourite thing is the plants they've put around the building.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'favourite thing' = likes the plants best.
• Đáp án đúng: cinema
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'Like the new cinema? Nah... I can't see any advantage in having it there...'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'can't see any advantage' = unnecessary.
